story.title: One wedding.
story.text: You will receive an invitation, a role, and a reason to dress up. The rest will happen naturally — over dinner, music, and conversations late into the night.

seo.heading: Fake Wedding: a unique way to spend an evening in Riga
seo.description: A theatrical role-playing social event for adults: meet new people, take on a role, share conversations and enjoy a memorable evening in Riga. Ideal for anyone looking for a unique party, fun things to do and new connections.

privacy.title: Personal Data Processing Policy
privacy.lead: Here, in plain language, we explain what data we use and how we protect it with care.
privacy.asideText: We use your data only to organise your participation in the event.

sections.title: What data we collect
sections.text: When you submit an invitation request, we process your name, email address and phone number. The selected website language may also be processed for technical purposes.

sections.title: How we use data
sections.text: Data is used only to process your request, communicate about the Fake Wedding event and send organisational information. We do not sell or share personal data with third parties for their own marketing purposes.

sections.title: Legal basis for processing
sections.text: We process data based on your consent, which you give by ticking the checkbox in the form. You may withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us at the phone number shown on the website.

sections.title: Retention and protection
sections.text: We retain data only as long as necessary to organise the event and communicate about your request. We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect it.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You can request access to, correction or deletion of your data, as well as restrict its processing. To exercise these rights, contact us by phone

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.text: We may update this policy. The current version is always published on this page.
